diagram:
flowchart TD
  TRIG["⚡ On-Demand or After Research"] --> THEME["🎯 Identify Active Themes"]
  THEME --> CAND["🔍 Find Thematic Candidates"]
  CAND --> SCORE["📊 Theme Score"]
  SCORE --> FILTER{"Score >= 60?"}
  FILTER -->|Yes| ADD["➕ Add to Watchlist"]
  FILTER -->|No| DROP["❌ Drop"]
  ADD --> EXPIRE["⏳ 7-day Auto-Expiry"]

TRIG.label: On-Demand Trigger
TRIG.description: Runs manually from Agents page or chained after ResearchAgent. No fixed daily schedule — themes last weeks.
TRIG.addReason: Thematic scanning doesn't need daily cadence. Themes last weeks to months.

THEME.label: Identify Active Themes
THEME.description: LLM identifies 3-5 active market themes (AI infrastructure, robotics, nuclear, GLP-1) based on news and momentum.
THEME.addReason: Pure fundamental screening misses narrative-driven moves.

CAND.label: Find Thematic Candidates
CAND.description: Searches stocks matching themes via Alpha Vantage sector data + FinancialDatasets by industry.
CAND.addReason: Translates abstract themes into specific tickers.

SCORE.label: Theme Score
SCORE.description: Scores on momentum (RSI, price vs MA), narrative fit (LLM assessment), sector strength.
SCORE.addReason: Not every stock in a theme deserves watchlist. Score filters highest conviction.

FILTER.label: Score Filter
FILTER.description: Score >= 60 passes. Failed candidates logged but not added.
FILTER.addReason: Quality filter — avoid polluting watchlist with weak bets.

ADD.label: Add to Watchlist
ADD.description: Adds with source='theme_scout', theme tag, expiry. Shows 🎯 badge in Watchlist panel.
ADD.addReason: Watchlist staging area before ResearchAgent deep-analyzes.

EXPIRE.label: 7-Day Auto-Expiry
EXPIRE.description: ThemeScout additions auto-expire after 7 days if ResearchAgent hasn't traded them.
EXPIRE.addReason: Themes time-sensitive. Stale picks clutter watchlist.
